package.description: Mount restic backup repositories as Windows drives or folders using WinFsp.

en-US.description: Mount restic backup repositories as Windows drives or folders using WinFsp.
en-US.longDescription: A standalone CLI tool to natively mount restic repositories as virtual drives (or folders) on Windows. Pure Go binary dynamically linking to WinFsp at runtime without CGO. Provides full upstream CLI compatibility with restic mount.
en-US.name: restic-mount
